transactionsPage.title: Transactions
transactionsPage.about: Every money and credit movement on your account — plan purchases, credit top-ups and usage, and delivery-fee earnings.
transactionsPage.description: Every money and credit movement on your account — plan purchases, credit top-ups and delivery-fee earnings

transactions.searchLabel: Search this page by description or category
transactions.filterDescription: Category filters the whole ledger; search looks at the page you're on.
transactions.internalNote: Moved between your own balances — not counted as money in or out.

plan.capHint: Shipments not yet in a terminal state, counted against your plan's soft cap.

plan.pendingStarts: Starts when your current plan ends.
plan.pendingStartsOn: Starts when your current plan ends on {{date}}.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Upgrade any time — a paid plan you buy now starts when your current one ends.
plans.queuedTitle: A plan is already queued to start when your current one ends.

wallet.title: Credit wallet
wallet.description: Top up your agency credit balance. Credits never expire and power upcoming credit-metered features.
wallet.negative: Your balance is negative after a refunded or disputed top-up. Top up to bring it back to positive.
wallet.noPacks: No credit packs available right now.

web.payCard: Paying by card is done on the web dashboard at {{host}}. Mobile money works right here.
web.saveCard: Cards are saved on the web dashboard at {{host}}. You can save a mobile money number here.

storage.title: Media storage
storage.full: Your media storage is full. New uploads will be rejected until you free up space.
storage.nearFull: You've used {{percent}}% of your media storage.
storage.footnote: Every file your agency owns counts here — your avatar, your business logo, anything you upload, and the delivery proofs your agents attach to their shipments.

methods.title: Payment methods
methods.description: Saved wallets pre-fill checkout. We only ever show the last four digits of a number.
methods.atLimit: You can save up to {{count}} methods.
methods.empty: No saved payment methods yet. Add one to speed up checkout.
methods.pickNewDefault: Pick a new default payment method.
methods.removeDescription: {{label}} will be removed. This can't be undone.

add.description: Save a mobile money wallet to speed up checkout.
